subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with a suitable word of your own based on the information in the text. 0.
stimulus: Mr Islam who (a) — very brilliant as a student, (b) — a qualified farmer in Naogaon. After (c) - -- his higher education from Bangladesh Agricultural University in Mymensingh he (d) — home and (e) — advanced (f) —. His another two brothers (g) — graduates in different areas. They all (h) — fame in their own fields. They were very (i) — with their life. They never (j) — their roots.
guide_solution: a. was; b. is; c. completing/finishing; d. came back/returned; e. started; f. farming; g. are; h. have; i. pleased; j. forgot.
